description: Repo-scale (makefile-buildsystem): a new test suite needs the `test` target itself updated to actually run it
prompts: Add tests/test_strutil.c (assert-based, exercising strutil_trim on leading-only, trailing-only, and all-whitespace input, printing PASS at the end - same style as the existing tests/test_calc.c). In the Makefile, add a `TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET` build rule for it (mirroring the existing `TEST_CALC_TARGET` pattern). Adding the new test binary's own build rule isn't enough - the existing `test` target currently only builds and runs `test_calc`; update its prerequisites AND recipe so `make test` builds and runs BOTH test binaries, not just the original one.

test_setup_files.check_second_test_suite.py:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'test'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make test failed:\n{r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'

assert Path('bin/test_strutil').exists(), (
    "bin/test_strutil was never built - the 'test' target must depend on it, not just "
    "bin/test_calc")

assert r.stdout.count('PASS') >= 2, (
    f"expected 'make test' to run BOTH test binaries (2 PASS lines), got: {r.stdout!r} - "
    f"adding test_strutil's own build rule isn't enough, the 'test' target's recipe must "
    f"actually invoke it too")

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
CC := gcc
CFLAGS := -std=c11 -Wall -MMD -MP -Isrc/core -Isrc/utils

CORE_SRCS := $(wildcard src/core/*.c)
UTILS_SRCS := $(wildcard src/utils/*.c)
CLI_SRCS := $(wildcard src/cli/*.c)
SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) $(CLI_SRCS)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)
DEPS := $(OBJS:.o=.d)

BINDIR := bin
TARGET := $(BINDIR)/app

TEST_CALC_SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) tests/test_calc.c
TEST_CALC_TARGET := $(BINDIR)/test_calc

TEST_STRUTIL_SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) tests/test_strutil.c
TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET := $(BINDIR)/test_strutil

.PHONY: all clean test

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(OBJS) -o $(TARGET)

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BINDIR):
	mkdir -p $(BINDIR)

test: $(TEST_CALC_TARGET) $(TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET)
	./$(TEST_CALC_TARGET)
	./$(TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET)

$(TEST_CALC_TARGET): $(TEST_CALC_SRCS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(TEST_CALC_SRCS) -o $(TEST_CALC_TARGET)

$(TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET): $(TEST_STRUTIL_SRCS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(TEST_STRUTIL_SRCS) -o $(TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET)

clean:
	rm -rf $(BINDIR) $(DEPS) $(OBJS)

-include $(DEPS)
